briefing.headline: OpenAI o4-preview and xAI Grok-3 accelerate AGI race as US export controls tighten on advanced chips

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs race to deploy multimodal agents while governments scramble for compute dominance. Prompt injection attacks surge in production systems, highlighting urgent need for protocol-level defenses.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview scoring 92% on GPQA; Anthropic Claude 4 Opus launched with 2M context; xAI Grok-3 and DeepSeek-R2 push open-source boundaries.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft commits $4B to new Texas supercluster; TSMC ramps 2nm AI chips; Google TPU v6 pods reach 100k scale with record efficiency gains.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will export controls on advanced semiconductors slow China's frontier model progress by more than 18 months?
